entries.title: Welcome to STILLPOINT 1.0 & Road to 1.1
entries.summary: STILLPOINT is launching free on iPhone with zero forced ads. Here is what is coming next in our first major post-launch update.
bullets: 3 Wasteland Factions with weekly shared kill objectives and faction emblem rewards.
Weekly Developer 1-of-1 Vault Auctions where veterans bid Shards on handcrafted unique coatings.
Player Skin Marketplace built on server-verified accounts so rare pattern seeds and low-float FN drops can be traded for Shards.
Weekly Seeded Challenge Runs with exclusive serialized leaderboard trophies.

entries.title: v1.0.0 Launch Release
entries.summary: Full 1.0 release featuring tightened Stillpoint Focus economy with Reactor Stall risk, painted gritty industrial combat hardware and explosions, Direct Drag controls, and per-sector synth soundtracks.
bullets: Stillpoint & Reactor Stall: slower Focus recharge rewards smart slow-mo budgeting and aggressive bullet grazing, while draining Focus to 0% triggers a 2.4s Reactor Stall lockout.
Added Emergency Vent and Thermal Siphon Pick-10 Loadout modules.

Full Combat Visual Overhaul: painted industrial sprites for every deployed turret, drone, sawblade, flail, mine, missile, mortar, kunai, scythe, and pickup, plus gritty tracer ordnance, multi-layered lasers, and 4-frame volumetric explosions.
Added Direct 1:1 Drag alongside Floating Stick, Pause Build Inspector with Evolution hints, and Run-End Damage Breakdown bars.
Composed 4 distinct synth soundtracks for Ash Flats, Sunken Metro, Slag Foundry, and The Monolith.
Added optional Armory Scanner Boost (+50% crate odds for 3 runs, max 2/day), iCloud save sync, and Game Center leaderboards.
